{{Quote|My father fought with the Republic Navy at Venestria and Ord Trasi, and was aboard one of the old Tectors&mdash;the Archer, she was called&mdash;when the Separatists shut down their clankers and the war stopped.|From the memoirs of Isila Drutch|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
The '''''Archer''''' was a [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] that was used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and measured one mile in length.<ref name="Mile" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] deactivated its [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> thereby ending the Clone Wars, the [[Isila Drutch's father|father]] of the future [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Isila Drutch]] was serving aboard the ''Archer''. Drutch mentioned that fact in their [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]] memoirs, in which they characterized the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] as one of the "old" ''Tector''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Archer'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
